summary: Mandatory clearance certifying fire safety preparedness for commercial premises, restaurants, hotels, and event spaces.

steps.title: Install approved fire fighting apparatus
steps.description: Equip premises with certified ABC fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, emergency exit signage, and hose reels.

steps.title: Submit online NOC application
steps.description: Log in to municipal portal and provide building approval number, occupant capacity, and hazardous material disclosures.

steps.title: Schedule site inspection
steps.description: Fire station officer will schedule an on-site audit of egress routes, fire alarms, and extinguisher validity.

steps.title: Rectify compliance observations
steps.description: If discrepancies are noted during inspection, complete compliance actions within 15 calendar days.

steps.title: Issuance of Fire Safety Certificate
steps.description: Download renewable 1-year Fire Safety Certificate from municipal portal.
